floor_history.headline: Recon confirmed: honest floor 2 (83/83 insns); sole residual is a 2-insn sched2 tie in the prologue cluster (sll $3,$18,4 vs the $16 save/copy). No rules, no cheat-asm.

frontier.hypothesis: Read the sched2 tie directly and derive a C spelling that inverts INSN_PRIORITY between the sll and the move16.
frontier.mechanism: sched.c INSN_PRIORITY = longest downstream dependence chain. Instrumented cc1 (or -da RTL dump) will show the exact chain length for each and identify which downstream insn is the pivot.
frontier.next_probe: Preprocess text1a_c.c to base.i; run tools/gcc-2.7.2/build/cc1 <build-flags> -da base.i; extract sched2 priorities for the prologue-region insns of func_80045294 (or a BB2_SCHED_DEBUG instrumented cc1). Then propose a C spelling that lengthens move16's downstream chain (e.g. immediate consumer of `i` in first arg position) or shortens sll's.

frontier.hypothesis: s5 chain restructuring: express `s5 = s4 + a1` so its addu no longer extends sll's downstream chain, while still landing addu $21,$20,$19 in the beqz delay slot.
frontier.mechanism: The sll priority derives from sll->addu $1->lw $20->addu $21. Breaking that chain at addu $1 (address computation for the table load) or at addu $21 (via a different source for s5) drops sll's priority below move16's.
frontier.next_probe: Try spellings: (a) reload the table value via a walking pointer so lw $20's address does not derive from sll; (b) derive s5 from a reloaded value or a semantically-equivalent expression; sandbox each. Pure-C only, no dead stores/barriers.

frontier.hypothesis: Permuter campaign with a CLEAN single-function target.o sweeping prologue-region spellings.
frontier.mechanism: Random + directed PERM_* mutations of guard forms (if/do-while vs while vs for), v1/s4/s5 expression spellings, statement placements — cross-product beyond hand probes. Fresh-seed discipline (~20-30 seeds) per [[permuter-fresh-seed-discipline]]. Clean target.o built from asm/funcs/func_80045294.s + prelude so the base score is the real weighted diff (no ~340k branch-address noise).
frontier.next_probe: Build target.o via decomp-permuter prelude; run permuter with --stop-on-zero on candidate.c; monitor for closing forms and cheat-vet each one before proposing.
